page.metaTitle: NIS2 Asset Inventory: free, no signup, shareable link
page.metaDescription: Build your BSI Grundschutz 200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse in 5 minutes. One big pre-checked list. Uncheck what doesn't apply, add what's missing. Save and share via link. Free, no signup, no PII.

hero.headline: NIS2 Asset Inventory
hero.headlineAccent: in 5 minutes, with a shareable link
hero.subhead: We pre-check the assets a Mittelstand company typically has. Uncheck what doesn't apply, add what's missing. Every state is one link you can save or send to a colleague.

intro.trustLine: BSI-200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse, five-layer Informationsverbund. NIS2 Art 21(2)(i), BSIG §30(2) Nr. 9. Your data lives in the URL fragment only; the server never sees it.

share.mailSubject: Help me complete our NIS2 asset inventory
share.mailBody:
Hi,

I started our NIS2 asset inventory for §30 BSIG / Art 21(2)(i) NIS2. Can you check what your department uses and tick / untick anything as needed? Then send the new link back to me.

Link: {url}

No signup, your edits update the link automatically.

Thanks.

disclaimer.methodologyDisclosure: Asset inventory aligned with BSI-200-2 §8.1 Strukturanalyse (five-layer Informationsverbund + Gruppenbildung per Lektion 3). Output is a first-pass inventory you can hand to a consultant or feed into the risk assessment. Full §8.1 conformance also requires a current Netzplan (network diagram), dependency edges between layers, and management body sign-off (§38 BSIG, Art 20 NIS2). Inventory state lives in the URL fragment only; the server never receives it.
